response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_ram_usage, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat
